free_tier.stated: Free trial plan: up to 1,000 MAUs, unlimited messages per month and 'Unlimited' message storage, but messages are retained for six months; no credit card required
free_tier.notes: Headline offer; binding constraint specified in limits.

per_object_cap.stated: No per-object cap documented in published terms; absence is not an unlimited claim.
per_object_cap.notes: extraction found no per-object clause; some of these providers meter on object count rather than bytes, and some state no cap

retention.stated: 6-MONTH RETENTION, stated twice on the pricing page

egress.terms: No per-GB egress line; file downloads go through Sendbird's API with an application ID and usually a session/access token.

tooling: sendbird-platform-api + the Chat SDKs (JS/iOS/Android/Flutter). Solid SDK, wrong product shape for a filesystem.
chaining: Does not chain: unlimited storage is real only inside a 6-month sliding window, so total held bytes are bounded by write rate x 182 days.

limits.value: messages are retained for 6 months on the free trial plan; extended retention is an Enterprise feature

limits_note: 6-MONTH RETENTION, stated twice on the pricing page. 'Unlimited' message storage is therefore a rate allowance, not a capacity. Extended retention is an Enterprise (paid) feature. The exact upsell that tells you retention is the metered axis.
